rail_envelope.caption: The corpus under this arm, measured 2026-09-30 on the engine that drew these pairs (rail comp ON both sides): symmetric → envelope where they differ, one figure where they do not. bare satin % is the satin-only bare instrument (tools/rail_edge.bare_area); wobble std and unsewn outline are tools/edge_wobble; overshoot is tools/dropped_elements. The last column is where the envelope's NEW thread lands in the artwork: on golden_tee 30.6 of its 45.3 mm² is the 3D lettering's white keylines, which that instrument reads as filled knockouts (lost elements 69 → 76, artfid 77.4 → 76.8) while the bare-satin instrument reads the same thread as coverage; on becker 17.0 of 22.9 mm² is ink of the right colour and every instrument agrees. thermal is drone's artwork byte for byte and is not repeated; MARINE is the suite's fixture, not a page logo.
columns: new thread mm² (on ink / on white)
